issue.title: Dirty hidden plans clone wedges the shared artifact-link write lane for all agents
issue.description:
The machine artifact-link write lane is refusing every write with
`plans: hidden clone has uncommitted or untracked changes; preserving
/home/bryan/.sase/projects/gh_sase-org__sase/repos/plans`.

Observed twice directly in this turn (2026-09-14 ~09:0x-09:4x EDT): `sase artifact link
add bead:sase-10v related bead:sase-10s "<reason>"` exited 1 with that error, and the
post-commit `sase stitch create --resume` finalizer printed `Could not drain
artifact-link read outbox: plans: hidden clone has uncommitted or untracked changes`.
Not a one-off: at least seven task beads from the last ~day (sase-10e, sase-10g,
sase-10i, sase-10n, sase-10o, sase-10t, sase-106) carry notes that typed related links
had to be recorded as prose because this same error refused the write, and sase-10e's
note says the hidden plans clone holds another agent's untracked links.

So one agent's stranded uncommitted/untracked state in the hidden host-owned plans
clone has been blocking every other agent's link writes and outbox drains for hours,
and nothing reconciles or quarantines that state — the lane just preserves the dirty
clone and fails. Worker should inspect what is actually sitting dirty in
~/.sase/projects/gh_sase-org__sase/repos/plans, recover or quarantine it, and then make
the write lane self-heal (e.g. commit-or-stash-and-quarantine the foreign state with an
audit note, or use a per-writer scratch clone) so a single crashed writer cannot wedge
the shared lane indefinitely. Related closed bead sase-ye covered the no-retry half of
publication stranding; this is the dirty-clone half.

task_type_fields.impact: Every agent's typed related links and artifact-link outbox drains have been refused for hours; relations degrade to prose notes on beads.
task_type_fields.location: ~/.sase/projects/gh_sase-org__sase/repos/plans (hidden host-owned clone used by the machine artifact-link write lane)
task_type_fields.repro: sase artifact link add bead:<a> related bead:<b> '<reason>' — exits 1 with 'plans: hidden clone has uncommitted or untracked changes; preserving ...'; the post-commit outbox drain fails identically.

evidence.note: Reproduced while creating live-acceptance evidence for phase sase-xe.16.11.7.15.7: 'sase artifact create --move --bead ...' created file:explicit:b79d37e46dc8755ef4d5daef but failed to attach it with 'plans: hidden clone has uncommitted or untracked changes; preserving /home/bryan/.sase/projects/gh_sase-org__sase/repos/plans'.

Independent reproduction during sase-zw.8 landing on 2026-09-14: sase artifact create with --bead sase-zw.8 created file:explicit:1b136cd32d914b18447bed0a successfully but exited 1 while attaching it, reporting plans: hidden clone has uncommitted or untracked changes; preserving the hidden plans clone. Exact durable audit reference recorded in the parent bead note to keep the remaining-work handoff reviewable. No hidden-clone files modified.

Independent repro 2026-09-15 ~12:00 EDT: 'sase plan propose' and 'sase artifact link import-indexes' both exited 1 with 'plans: hidden clone has uncommitted or untracked changes; preserving ~/.sase/projects/gh_sase-org__sase/repos/plans'. Root dirt identified: single untracked legacy links index links/202609/prose_if_proc_directive_false_positive.md.json (553 bytes, one prompt_ref cites row from bbugyi200.athena.0j3--code, mtime 2026-09-11 07:26 EDT, absent from origin/main and from 'sase artifact link list'). Impact: wedged every sidecar-syncing command for 4 days, including plan proposals.

payload.entry: RECOVERY 2026-09-15 ~12:03 EDT: the wedge is cleared. The single untracked file links/202609/prose_if_proc_directive_false_positive.md.json was quarantined out of the hidden clone after a sha256-verified backup (63bf78ca65d535524cd7aa7ac3dfff5beeebd0396ff52cb26a952454790c13e9): preserved durably as file:explicit:49cfb149110acf3f8110d8d7 (also at ~/tmp/sase_orphaned_links_backup/). The hidden clone is clean and the write lane accepts writes again (this note is proof). REMAINING SCOPE for the worker: (1) import the preserved cites row into the immutable link-event store — 'sase artifact link import-indexes' is the designed door, but note it refuses to run while the clone is dirty, which was self-defeating during the outage; (2) the original ask stands: make the lane self-heal (commit-or-quarantine foreign dirt with an audit note, or per-writer scratch clones) so one crashed writer cannot wedge every agent for days.

evidence.note: Independent reproduction 2026-09-15 ~16:4x EDT: 'sase artifact link add bead:sase-11g related bead:sase-kp ...' failed with 'plans: hidden clone has uncommitted or untracked changes; preserving /home/bryan/.sase/projects/gh_sase-org__sase/repos/plans' while filing an unrelated audit bead from workspace sase_25. The artifact-link write lane is still wedged for all agents.

Same root cause and remediation as this task; no duplicate created.

Independent reproduction 2026-09-15 ~22:4x EDT: 'sase plan propose sase_plan_hold_directive.md' (validated epic) exited 1 with 'plans: hidden clone has uncommitted or untracked changes; preserving /home/bryan/.sase/projects/gh_sase-org__sase/repos/plans' — so the wedge blocks plan proposals, not only artifact-link writes/outbox drains. Diagnosis: exactly one untracked file, links/202609/sase110_completion_1.md.json (stranded link write). Unwedged by quarantining it (path preserved, content intact) to /home/bryan/.sase/projects/gh_sase-org__sase/quarantine/plans/links/202609/sase110_completion_1.md.json; clone now clean. Worker: re-inject the quarantined link record and make the lane self-heal per description.

The published file remains available; the artifact-link lane is wedged again after prior recoveries. No hidden-clone files changed.

Independent reproduction during sase-124 landing at 155aeee2ef on 2026-09-17: sase artifact create --path /tmp/sase_124_land_repro.py --label "sase-124 deterministic capacity and attention landing reproductions" --bead sase-124 created file:explicit:7149138b09eabe6ff5ba5226, then exited 1 because attaching its ref hit "plans: hidden clone has uncommitted or untracked changes; preserving /home/bryan/.sase/projects/gh_sase-org__sase/repos/plans". Snapshot without --bead and audited reads succeeded, so the new reproduction isolates the shared link-write lane. The 2026-09-15 recovery note did not prevent recurrence. No foreign clone read, reset or edit was attempted; audit refs retained in sase-124 notes.

Independent recurrence from land agent sase-124.8.land on 2026-09-17: after creating node-specific flake task sase-129 as required by retired umbrella sase-ct, 'sase artifact link add bead:sase-129 related bead:sase-ct ...' failed with 'plans: hidden clone has uncommitted or untracked changes'. The task bead itself was created successfully; only the required typed related-link write was blocked.

Independent recurrence during sase-123.7 landing at 80336097ad: three sase artifact create --bead sase-123.7 calls created durable audit/actual/expected snapshots but exited 1 while attaching them, with plans: hidden clone has uncommitted or untracked changes. Audit ref file:explicit:e8b9c4338d74ab54ee9e348b, actual file:explicit:89b3629330021159e922d710, expected file:explicit:a276711d01074f55e3581a95. References preserved in epic note and remaining-work plan. Bead +1 and note writes succeeded; only the shared artifact-link attachment lane failed. Did not read or modify the foreign hidden clone. Same known root/remediation; no duplicate task.

Still wedged 2026-09-18 ~10:52 UTC. The only dirty path in the hidden plans clone is the untracked links/202609/leader_hint_collapse_all_tribes.md.json (mtime 2026-09-13 23:12:35 UTC; HEAD 7a968045 'Archive approved plan services_tab'). New impact: 'sase plan propose' on a tale plan with a links: frontmatter entry (ref file:explicit:..., relation related) failed with 'plans: hidden clone has uncommitted or untracked changes', AFTER it had already consumed the scratch sase_plan_*.md into ~/.sase/plans/202609/ with no proposal registered ('sase plan list' showed 0 proposed). Propose is non-atomic under this failure: the author must recreate the scratch file from the archive and drop links: to get a proposal through.
